projects.name: SDDOT STIP 2027 (Approved) - Construction Reconstruction
projects.notes: One layer per improvement category of the approved STIP map; the layer itself is the work type. Most relevant for land acquisition (grading, reconstruction). No status field: everything here is programmed, not yet built. FiscalYear and ConstructionYear are text years; LettingDate is often null. EstCost is dollars. Other fields: HwyNbr, BegMRMNbr/EndMRMNbr (mile markers), SegmentLen, FundCat1-5, ProjectList (control number + project number), ProjectManager, ReadyDate. MapCategory sample value 'Con/Recon'. Coordinates are a South Dakota projected system (ask for outSR=4326).

projects.notes: Longer-range (2031-2034) projects. Very thin attributes: only HwyNbr, ProjectCtrlNbr, ProjectList, RankingVal, ReadyDate, RYG, ProjectManager - no description or cost. Layer 17 holds 3 matching points.

projects.name: SDDOT STIP 2027 (Approved) - Local Structure Projects
projects.notes: County/local bridge projects; different field set (has ProjectNbr and TranspProjectStatusCode; only the value 'Recommended' was seen in a sample, the full list was not pulled). Layer 11 (Local Road Projects, 4 lines) and layer 9 (Railroad Crossings, 41 points) are similar small layers.

summary: Projects found: SDDOT's approved STIP map service gives planned projects as lines per category with cost, year and county (found by opening the map linked from dot.sd.gov; the tentative STIP is a sibling service STIP/DOT_STIP_Tentative on the same server). Parcels not yet researched.
